color.summary: White pages, black #000000 text (older surfaces still use #211922) and #62625b for quiet text. Pinterest red #e60023 fills the main action; warm grey #e5e5e0 fills secondary buttons, chips and the search bar. Control edges are #91918c and focus is blue #435ee5. Trends and search guides tint their chips in soft pastels (#eef7de, #ebe2fd, #c7f0da, #fbdfff).
usage: The dark theme exists in the web app's token bundle but signed-out pages never show it.

type.summary: Pin Sans everywhere: 16px at 500 on buttons, chips and tabs, 16/22.4 for body text, 14px for secondary copy and 12px for legal links. Headings are 700: 20px on cards, 28px with -0.5px tracking on page titles.

shape.summary: Soft and large: 16px corners on buttons, chips, fields and the flyout, 8px on tooltips and pin images, 20 to 32px on pins and modals. The search bar is a pill.

spacing.summary: Touch-sized: the main buttons and the search bar are 48px with 14px padding; form buttons drop to 36px with 10px. Chips and tiles gap at 8 to 12px.

elevation.summary: One shadow, 0 3px 12px black at 20%, under the login modal and the flyout. Buttons and chips are flat fills; focus is a 2px #435ee5 outline with a 2px white inner border.

button.summary: Gestalt-style buttons: red for the main action, gray for the rest, both 48px at lg with 16px corners and 16px labels at 500. Outlined white buttons carry the social sign-ins. Most of this grid is pins and trend tiles, which the markup marks as buttons.

provenance.notes: Written block by block from the census (spec.json, census 154a8a6) and its page shots: six public, signed-out pages (a profile, ideas, a pin, search, business sign-up, Trends), light only. Partial: dark mode, menus, settings and the other selection controls are signed in only. Names marked docs are Gestalt's public prop values (color, size); names marked ai are ours.
